line.a_burza.text: A storm is coming! Tonight everybody must be at home.

line.a_kurki.text: And my hens are walking on the meadow. They must go back into the pen.

line.a_plot.text: I'll build them a fence! All around, like this.

line.a_uciekla.text: Oh no, a hen got out!

line.a_dziura.text: There's a gap in the fence. You can get out through a gap.

line.a_zamkniety.text: A fence must be closed all the way round. Then what is inside stays inside.

line.a_narysuj.text: Draw a fence around all the hens with your finger. Bring your finger back to where you started.

line.a_otwarta.text: There's a gap left in the fence! Close it all the way round to the start.

line.a_nie_wszystkie.text: Not all the hens are inside. Draw the fence around all of them.

line.a_w_srodku.text: All the hens are inside the pen. Thank you!

line.a_kaczuszka.text: And the duckling is in the basket!

line.a_obok.text: Beaver, the duckling is standing next to the basket, not inside it.

line.a_wloz.text: Put the duckling inside the basket. Drag it.

line.a_wloz_nie.text: Not inside yet. Drag the duckling right into the basket.

line.a_teraz_w_srodku.text: Now I see. Next to is not inside!

line.b_zabawa.text: A game before the rain! I'm drawing a circle on the grass. The circle is our little house.

line.b_kto.text: Point to who is still outside the circle.

line.b_kto_nie.text: That one is inside the circle. Who is standing outside it?

line.b_deszcz.text: It's raining! Quick, into Hedgehog's burrow!

line.b_grzmot.text: Oh no! The thunder scared the duckling. She jumped out of the basket and ran off into the bushes!

line.b_krete.text: There are winding paths between the bushes. The duckling won't find my burrow on her own.

line.b_poprowadzmy.text: Let's lead her there! Inside the burrow the rain can't get her wet.

line.b_labirynt.text: Lead the duckling with your finger along the path, all the way to the burrow door. She can't go through the bushes.

line.b_kaczuszka_dom.text: The duckling is inside the burrow! Now us, let's run!

line.b_kaczuszko.text: Little duckling, there you are! Inside, dry and warm.

line.b_norka.text: It's dry and warm in the burrow. The rain stayed outside.

line.b_koniec.text: Outside there's a storm, and we're inside, in the warm burrow.

line.p_start.text: Let's play inside and outside! I have five games.

line.p_owce.text: Draw a fence around the sheep. The wolf must stay outside.

line.p_owce_nie.text: Look: inside there must be only the sheep, all of them. The wolf outside.

line.p_jablka.text: Put three apples into the basket. Drag them one at a time.

line.p_poza.text: Point to the star that is outside the circle.

line.p_poza_nie.text: That star is inside the circle. Look for the one outside it.

line.p_kubki.text: I'm hiding a ball under a cup. Watch carefully!

line.p_gdzie_pilka.text: Point to the cup the ball is in.

line.p_gdzie_pilka_nie.text: This cup is empty. Try again.

line.p_rybka.text: The goldfish wants to swim. Let her into the bowl.

line.p_rybka_nie.text: The goldfish is still outside. Drag her into the water, inside the bowl.

line.p_rybka_ok.text: The goldfish is swimming inside the bowl!

line.h_zabawki.text: What a mess! Before bed the toys go back into the box.

line.h_w_pudle.text: The toys are inside the box, and the basket is on the rug!

line.h_rodzice.text: Play it with your parents like we did: hide a toy in a box or put it next to it. Where is it: inside or outside?

line.a_aha.text: I see! A fence with no gap, closed all the way round.

line.b_szyba.text: Oh, the warm stove has steamed up the window! We can't see what's outside.

line.b_potem.text: When the storm is over, we'll go home to sleep.

line.p_owce_ok.text: Yes! The sheep are inside, and the wolf stayed outside.

line.p_jablka_ok.text: Yes, three apples are inside the basket!

line.p_poza_ok.text: Yes, this star is outside the circle!

line.p_pilka_ok.text: There it is! The ball was inside this cup.

line.h_dom.text: The storm is over. We're at home, everybody inside!

line.h_bobr_juz.text: I'll help! Teddy is in the box already.

line.h_obok.text: Beaver, Teddy is next to the box, not inside it.

line.h_aha.text: Oops, again! Next to is not inside.

line.h_sprzatnij.text: Drag the toys inside the box, and put the duckling's basket on the rug.

line.h_sprzatnij_nie.text: The toys into the box, the basket onto the rug.

line.h_gra.text: Now a guessing game! I'll take one toy out and put it next to the box.

line.h_gra_kto.text: Point to the toy that is outside the box.

line.h_gra_nie.text: That toy is inside the box. Which one is next to it?

line.h_gra_ok.text: Yes, the ball is outside, next to the box!

line.h_bajka.text: The duckling won't sleep. She wants a story about her evening!

line.h_bajka_uloz.text: Put the pictures in order, from what happened first.

line.h_bajka_nie.text: Look again at what came first and what came next.

line.h_bajka_ok.text: First the duckling sat in the basket. Then the thunder! She ran off, but she found the burrow and went inside.

line.h_spac.text: And now, sleep! Put the duckling inside the basket.

line.h_dobranoc.text: The duckling sleeps in the basket, the toys are in the box, and we're all at home. Good night!

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for getting everybody safely home! Here is a sticker for your album, as a keepsake. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you!

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is Hedgehog's hen. We got it when we closed the pen before the storm.
